other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Reference title cites continuous production as a future concept for chemical modular plants, but only in the bibliography, not applied
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
“Future Production 
Concepts in the Chemical Industry: Modular - Small-Scale - 
Continuous,” Chem. Eng. Technol., vol. 36, no. 6, pp. 900–910, 2013.

one_line: A conceptual proposal for integrating ISO 50001 energy management into modular process plants (chemical/pharmaceutical) via the Module Type Package, with only a planned future evaluation and no empirical demonstration in any continuous-production context.
